title: Create src/commands/tasks.ts and wire TasksApp
description: Implement the full tasks command handler. Checks for tasks.json, reads tasks, and renders the TasksApp TUI. Handles missing tasks.json and empty task lists gracefully.
acceptanceCriteria: rocket tasks renders the TasksApp TUI
Missing .agent/tasks.json shows a helpful error message
Empty task list shows 'No tasks found' message
Initial filter from --filter flag is applied

steps.details: Replace stub with: import { render } from 'ink'. Import TasksApp, readTasks, path, fs. async function tasksCommand(options) { const agentDir = path.join(process.cwd(), '.agent'); if (!await fs.pathExists(path.join(agentDir, 'tasks.json'))) { console.error('No .agent/tasks.json found. Run rocket init first.'); process.exit(1) } const tasks = await readTasks(agentDir); if (tasks.length === 0) { console.log('No tasks found in tasks.json'); return } render(<TasksApp tasks={tasks} agentDir={agentDir} initialFilter={options.filter} />) }

steps.description: Verify TUI renders and is navigable
steps.details: Run `npm run dev -- tasks` in a project with tasks.json. Verify the task list renders and arrow keys navigate it.
